headline: ConocoPhillips Doubles Q3 Profit to $4B, Raises Dividend
summary: ConocoPhillips reported third-quarter profit more than doubled to $4 billion, driven by higher crude prices. The company also raised its quarterly dividend by 11% and beat Wall Street earnings estimates.
why: ConocoPhillips is one of the world's largest independent upstream oil producers, and its earnings serve as a key barometer for the profitability of the exploration and production sector.

impacts.name: ConocoPhillips
impacts.why: Higher quarterly profit and an 11% dividend increase directly reflect strong financial performance and benefit equity holders.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The company's earnings of $3.27 per share beat Wall Street's $2.97 estimate, while profit more than doubled and dividends were raised due to higher crude prices.
